podcast.body: The cover of Prince's 1990 album "Graffiti Bridge" features a scientific photograph of subatomic particles in a bubble chamber. This identical image was also later used for The Strokes' North American "Is This It" cover and appeared on the cover of theoretical physicist Freeman Dyson's book, "The Scientist as Rebel." "It's been used in other places too, including on Princess 1990 graffiti bridge and on the cover of a book called The Scientist as Rebel by theoretical physicist Freeman Dyson."
